archive.name: fingerflex.zip
archive.integrity_scope: SHA-256 verified for the central directory and listed individual members. Whole-archive MD5 and SHA-1 are repository declarations.

processing_script.detail: The contributor links recording columns to locs rows and elec_regions, says bad channels were already removed and identifies code 2 as rolandic. Line 55 applies a common-average reference.

plotting_script.detail: Draws the individual brain surface and the recording contact positions in their shared rendering frame. An extra zero tuple in one plotting call is a plotting argument, outside the 46 source positions.

input.source_matlab_variable_order: Recording data column k = position row k = anatomical label row k. Source MATLAB indices begin at 1.

space.native: Original left frontoparietal grid and cortical mesh in the same individual rendering space. The task codebook and processing/plotting pair support channel-index registration. Source MATLAB fields have coordinate triples per contact; codebook does not explicitly label units, axes, origin, named template or a transform into another atlas.
space.figures: Miller et al. 2012 Figure 1A–C depicts this participant. Figure 12A shows a separate coherence analysis on this participant’s grid. Study Methods report approximately 4 mm accuracy for the localisation technique. This is method-level, not a measured error bar on these contacts.

references.title: Human Motor Cortical Activity Is Selectively Phase-Entrained on Underlying Rhythms
references.supports: Original measured subdural ECoG, task, acquisition, timing and individual contact localization. Figure 1A–C shows subject 1 in situ and reconstructed.

references.title: A library of human electrocorticographic data and analyses
references.supports: Depositor describes the source data library and anatomical registration.

references.title: Automated electrocorticographic electrode localization on individually rendered brain surfaces
references.supports: Validates the original method against photographs, median 2.6 mm across six studied subjects; not independent per-contact error estimates for the current specimen.

reproducibility.method: One-second periodic Hann periodogram of common-average referenced source counts converted to microvolts, within-pair ratios in dB. See analysis-plan.json and METHODS.md.
reproducibility.numerical_check: Direct real FFT using counts and an analytically constructed Hann window reproduces 216 regional fields within 0.0000005 dB and all 552 contact means under the published rounding.

attribution: Kai Joshua Miller, Stanford Digital Repository v11. The derived summaries use one cropped recording, common-average referencing, spectral power estimates and paired aggregation. Adapted materials under CC BY-SA 4.0. Use the verbatim ethics statement in METHODS.md in publications.
